contentEn:
Burnaby business owners planning a commercial renovation in 2026 face a wide cost range: small retail tenant improvements start around $45 per square foot, while a full interior demolition and rebuild can reach $280 per square foot or higher. The difference comes down to scope — and Burnaby's specific permit requirements for commercial spaces.

Reno Stars has completed five commercial renovation projects in Metro Vancouver, including three in Burnaby. This guide uses real project data from our portfolio and the Metro Vancouver Renovation Cost Index to give Burnaby business owners concrete budget expectations for 2026.

What Does a Commercial Renovation Cost in Burnaby in 2026?

A commercial renovation in Burnaby covers any improvement to a business premises, from a fresh paint and flooring refresh to a complete interior strip and rebuild. The City of Burnaby classifies most commercial tenant improvements under building permit requirements, and any work that changes occupancy, fire safety systems, or structural elements requires a full building permit — not just a trade permit.

Based on projects completed in Metro Vancouver in 2025–2026, here is what Burnaby business owners actually paid:

  • Toy store Metrotown, Burnaby — full interior refresh including new millwork, flooring, and signage: $125,000
  • Commercial warehouse Burnaby — loading dock upgrade, new partition walls, LED lighting throughout: $87,000
  • Dental clinic Burnaby — non-structural interior demolition and new treatment rooms, specialized flooring: $215,000

These figures reflect actual invoiced amounts from completed projects, not estimates.

Burnaby Commercial Renovation Cost by Scope

The single biggest cost variable in a Burnaby commercial renovation is the scope of work. A retail refresh — new flooring, paint, signage, and basic millwork — typically runs $45 to $85 per square foot. A mid-range tenant improvement with new partitions, upgraded electrical, and bathroom modifications runs $85 to $160 per square foot. A full interior demolition and rebuild, common for dental, medical, and restaurant conversions, runs $160 to $280 per square foot.

Burnaby's commercial zones — especially Metrotown, Brentwood, and the Great Northern Way corridor — have seen significant lease turnover in 2024–2025, driving a surge in tenant improvement projects. Demand for skilled commercial contractors in Burnaby has tightened lead times to 6–10 weeks for mid-size projects.

Burnaby-Specific Permit Requirements for Commercial Renovations

Commercial renovations in Burnaby require a building permit whenever the work affects fire separation, occupancy classification, mechanical systems, or structural elements. The City of Burnaby's permittimelines for commercial tenant improvements typically run 10–15 business days for routine applications, and longer if a change of use is involved.

For tenant improvements in Burnaby's Metrotown and Brentwood Town Centre areas, a change of use from one occupancy classification to another — for example, retail to restaurant — triggers a full change of use application in addition to the building permit. This adds 3–5 weeks to the approval timeline.

Electrical work in a commercial space must be performed by a licensed electrical contractor and requires a separate electrical permit through BC Hydro or the local electrical authority.

How Long Does a Commercial Renovation Take in Burnaby?

A small retail refresh in Burnaby (under 2,000 square feet) typically takes 3–5 weeks from permit approval to handover. A mid-size tenant improvement runs 6–10 weeks. A full interior demolition and rebuild for a medical or food-service space runs 10–18 weeks, with longer lead times for specialized equipment like negative pressure rooms or commercial kitchen hood systems.

Burnaby vs Vancouver Commercial Renovation: How Do Costs Compare?

Commercial renovation costs in Burnaby run 10–15% lower than equivalent work in Vancouver proper, primarily because City of Vancouver requires higher fees for commercial change-of-use applications and has longer permit timelines. Burnaby's proximity to Vancouver, lower lease costs, and strong transit connectivity (Skytrain access at Metrotown and Brentwood) make it attractive for retail, food service, and medical tenants who want Vancouver adjacency without Vancouver pricing.

Burnaby Commercial Renovation Cost FAQ

How much does a commercial renovation cost per square foot in Burnaby in 2026?

Retail refresh work runs $45–$85 per square foot. Mid-range tenant improvement runs $85–$160 per square foot. Full interior demolition and rebuild for medical, restaurant, or food-service use runs $160–$280 per square foot. These are invoiced figures from actual Burnaby and Metro Vancouver projects.

Does Burnaby require a building permit for a commercial renovation?

Yes. Any commercial renovation that changes occupancy, fire safety systems, mechanical systems, or structural elements requires a City of Burnaby building permit. A simple refresh (painting, flooring, new millwork) may qualify for a simplified trade permit process, but a change of use always requires a full building permit application.

How long does a commercial building permit take in Burnaby?

Standard commercial tenant improvement permits take 10–15 business days for approval. A change of use application adds 3–5 weeks. Projects involving fire safety upgrades or occupancy reclassification may require a longer review period.

Is Burnaby or Vancouver cheaper for a commercial renovation?

Burnaby is typically 10–15% less expensive than Vancouver proper for equivalent commercial renovation work, due to lower permit fees, shorter approval timelines, and more competitive contractor availability in the Burnaby/New Westminster market.

Can a Reno Stars project manage a full commercial renovation in Burnaby?

Yes. Reno Stars has completed commercial tenant improvements in Burnaby, Richmond, and Vancouver, including retail, warehouse, and medical spaces. We provide project management, permit coordination, and general contracting for commercial renovations in Metro Vancouver.
contentZh:
2026年本拿比商業裝修費用差異很大：小額零售店鋪改造每平方英尺約$45起，全面室內拆建則可達每平方英尺$280或更高。關鍵在於工程範圍，以及本拿比市對商業空間的具體許可要求。

聚星裝修已在Metro Vancouver完成五個商業裝修項目，其中三個在本拿比。本文以實際工程數據和Metro Vancouver裝修費用指數為本拿比商戶提供2026年具體預算參考。

本拿比商業裝修費用取決於工程範圍

工程範圍是影響本拿比商業裝修費用的最大變量。零售店鋪翻新——新地板、油漆、標識和基礎木作——通常為每平方英尺$45至$85。中檔商鋪改造（新建隔斷、升級電力和衛生間）為每平方英尺$85至$160。醫療、餐飲空間的全面室內拆建為每平方英尺$160至$280。

本拿比商業許可證要求

本拿比商業裝修工程凡涉及防火分隔、佔用分類改變、機械系統或結構構件，均須申請建築許可證。本拿比市MetroTown、Brentwood及Great Northern Way走廊一帶的商業許可申請審批時間通常為10至15個工作日；若涉及用途變更，審批時間更長。

本拿比與溫哥華商業裝修費用對比

本拿比商業裝修費用較溫哥華市同等工程低約10至15%，主因是溫哥華市對商業用途變更有更高費用和更長審批時間。本拿比毗鄰溫哥華、租賃成本較低，且有Skytrain便捷交通（MetroTown和Brentwood站），對零售、餐飲和醫療租戶具有吸引力。
